title: Platform
description: An assay platform (protein/antigen array, etc.) referenced by one or more dataset records. Normalized out of dataset.schema.json since many datasets reuse the same platform. Deliberately has no protein/feature count: the legacy data showed that count is reported per-study (varies with QC, version, subset analyzed), not a fixed platform attribute, so it lives on dataset.platforms[].n_proteins_reported instead.

platform_id.description: Stable slug for this platform, e.g. 'huprot-human-proteome-microarray'.

name.description: Platform name as reported in the source (e.g. 'HuProt Human Proteome Microarray').

technology.description: Free-text technology family, e.g. 'planar protein microarray', 'bead-based array'. Optional — leave null rather than guessing.
